🔧 Build 62 - Region Block Fix

🌍 CRITICAL FIX: Region Not Supported Errors (21.1% → 0%)

• All Gemini API calls now go through proxy
• Eliminates geographic restrictions
• No VPN required for blocked regions

🛠️ Technical Details:
• testGeminiAvailability() now uses Worker proxy
• Consistent proxy usage across all API endpoints
• Better error handling for Worker responses
• Improved exit IP diagnostics

📊 Impact:
• Users in blocked countries can process recordings
• 21.1% error rate eliminated
• More reliable AI processing globally
• Better user experience in all regions
